lines: Oh, Penni... I've been thinking about what happened in the sea.
I was so scared. I couldn't keep going, and I thought you might send me right back into another fight.

choices.text: I'm sorry, Silas. I should have kept you safe.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I won't push you past what you can handle. You can tell me when you need to stop.

lines: ...Thank you. I want to help you, but I need to know you'll listen.
I think I can try diving with you again.
I know I'm safe now. That's not really what I was trying to tell you.
I think I need some more time before I can go back out with you.
